title: Victoria Run 2026 Review: What the 2025 Edition Was Like
meta_description: Victoria Run review: Bank Victoria's race moved to GBK in October 2025 and drew 8,000 runners, with a concert at the finish. What to expect in 2026.
dek: Bank Victoria's anniversary race moved from BSD to Gelora Bung Karno in October 2025 and drew 8,000 people. Here is what that edition was like, ahead of 2026.
verdict: Victoria Run is a bank's anniversary race that has grown into a sizeable central-Jakarta event. The 2025 edition, on Sunday 12 October, moved from Q-Big BSD, where it had been held for two years, to the Gelora Bung Karno area, and drew 8,000 participants over 5 km, 10 km and the half marathon [1]. The Jakarta governor attended the 10 km flag-off, and the finish had a concert by Maliq & D'essentials and DJ sets [1]. If you want a festive, well-attended Jakarta race with a half-marathon option, it is worth entering.

sections.heading: The 2025 Edition
paragraphs: Victoria Run 2025 was held on Sunday 12 October at Gelora Bung Karno, Senayan, to mark Bank Victoria's 31st anniversary [1]. It had been held at Q-Big BSD for the previous two years, and the move to GBK was meant to give runners a more iconic setting and to bring the event closer to the city-centre running community [1].
The event director said participation reached 8,000 [1]. There were three categories: 5 km, 10 km and the half marathon [1].

sections.heading: The Atmosphere
paragraphs: The 10 km flag-off was led by the bank's owner and chief executive, with Jakarta governor Pramono Anung attending [1]. Runners had a concert by Maliq & D'essentials, DJ sets and sponsor booths after the race [1].
A blood drive was held two days before the race as part of the event [1].

sections.heading: Should You Enter the 2026 Race?
paragraphs: If you want a lively race in central Jakarta with music at the finish, yes. The move to GBK put it at the centre of the city's running scene.

It is a corporate anniversary event first, and the reporting reflects that: it covers the partners and the entertainment, not the course, timing or results. Check those details before you enter the half marathon.
This review is compiled from published reporting on the 2025 edition. It is not a first-hand race report, and nobody from this site ran the race.

faqs.question: How many people ran Victoria Run in 2025?
faqs.answer: The organisers said participation reached 8,000 on Sunday 12 October 2025, the first year the race was held at Gelora Bung Karno in Jakarta after two years at Q-Big BSD. The categories were 5 km, 10 km and the half marathon.

faqs.question: Where is Victoria Run held?
faqs.answer: Since 2025, in the Gelora Bung Karno area of Senayan, central Jakarta. Before that it was held for two years at Q-Big BSD in South Tangerang. The move was meant to bring it closer to the city's running community.

faqs.question: Who organises Victoria Run?
faqs.answer: PT Bank Victoria International, which holds the race to mark its anniversary. The 2025 edition celebrated the bank's 31st, with a concert by Maliq & D'essentials and DJ sets at the finish.

editorial_notes: Rewritten 2026-09-28 about the previous edition (12 October 2025). Replaces a pre-race preview. Another report gives 6,000 participants; the organiser's figure of 8,000 is used and attributed. No rating.
